exposure: Cord blood levels of 28 soluble immune factors (e.g., IL-17, IFNgamma, TNF-beta, MIP-1alpha, MIP-1beta, RANTES)
outcome: Lower respiratory tract infections (LRTIs) defined as bronchiolitis, bronchitis, or pneumonia
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 191 neonates from the Boston Birth Cohort.
finding: High cord blood levels of IFNgamma, TNF-beta, MIP-1alpha, and MIP-1beta were associated with an increased risk of LRTIs during infancy, while RANTES was associated with a lower risk.
